name: 10466 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10466 (Bronx) has 178 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10466 (Bronx) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.
